Also, you have to complete one out of the three Introductory Modules , and to choose five modules from the remaining elective modules . While choosing from the elective modules, you have to respect the following election rules: You may choose up to three Computer Science modules . These modules usually require Bachelor-level skills and knowledge in Computer Science. Please inform yourself about potential requirements before enrolling in these modules. From the modules offered in the Topics in the Study of Cultures section of the curriculum, you may likewise choose up to three modules , but you have to respect the following rules: You may choose one module from modules WP 13 to WP 29 . You may choose one module from modules WP 38-WP 43 and modules WP 45-WP 55 . You may choose one module from modules WP 44 and WP 61-WP 76 . These modules usually require previous knowledge in the respective discipline.
